verdict.rationale: Devin explicitly supports tackling Linear/Jira tickets directly (devin-docs-1), and its MCP support lets you connect external issue trackers (e.g., Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Monday.com) as tool servers so the agent can manage tickets (devin-docs-12/13/14). However, there's no evidence of native, first-class integrations or UI-level connectors for ClickUp/Monday.com specifically—only generic MCP-based extensibility—so PM-level 'connect and manage' support is partial and requires technical setup.
